test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 8 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following numbers will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

14, 17, 23, 35, 59, ?
solution:
Here, we have the pattern as:

The 1st term is added by 3 to get the next term, and again the next term is added by double of 3 (i.e. 6) to get the next term, and so on.

So, we have,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/80e9013f43e566774bb037e6e65ef23f6583ae95b55ded11043bdf6c062950f2.png] 

Hence, the next term is __**107**__ in the given series.
